purpose: Machine-readable registry for reusable semantic-light technical mechanisms shared across TAKY-governed systems. Semantic/domain authority remains with Work OS, Learning OS, family and project owners.
invariants: A shared implementation must expose a stable mechanism contract and explicit semantic exclusions.
A consumer migration is not complete until the consumer uses the shared contract and regression evidence exists.

capabilities.title: PWA safe update lifecycle state machine

mechanism_contract.required_transition_rule: activation is impossible from DOWNLOADED_WAITING until safe_point=true
mechanism_contract.family_semantic_hook: consumer supplies safe_point; shared primitive does not decide what counts as a safe learning/work state

semantic_exclusions: what constitutes a safe point for a learning session
what constitutes a safe point for a Work OS workflow
what user/session data must be restored
acceptance_conditions: waiting update cannot transition directly to activation without safe point
failure state is explicit
consumer supplies persistence/restore hooks
browser service-worker adapter remains a lower implementation adapter

capabilities.title: Immutable event envelope identity
semantic_exclusions: domain ordering semantics beyond an optional opaque sequence value

mechanism_contract.identity_rule: event_id is immutable event identity and MUST NOT be derived from payload/state digest
mechanism_contract.correlation_rule: correlation_id is optional transport correlation only and does not imply authority or ownership
mechanism_contract.idempotency_rule: idempotency_key defaults to event_id but may be supplied explicitly by the consumer
mechanism_contract.payload_rule: payload is an immutable snapshot inside the created envelope; payload_digest is integrity metadata, not event identity

acceptance_conditions: two events with identical payloads may have different event_id values
identical payload snapshots produce the same payload_digest
created envelopes are immutable
validation rejects payload-digest drift
the primitive does not infer identity, role, permission, domain ownership or event meaning

Ready-Set.scope: Ready local-first captures use immutable event envelope identity distinct from state/payload digest
Ready-Set.semantic_boundary: Ready retains scope meaning, family authentication, remote conflict detection, KEEP_LOCAL/ACCEPT_REMOTE resolution and IndexedDB schema ownership.
Ready-Set.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

Hide-Seek.semantic_boundary: Hide retains learning/session/capture event meaning and context projection; no shared identity/role/permission authority.

capabilities.title: Local durable outbox/retry/idempotency mechanism

mechanism_contract.retry_rule: retry count is bounded by max_attempts; exhaustion produces DEAD_LETTER
mechanism_contract.backoff_rule: exponential backoff is bounded by max_ms
mechanism_contract.ack_rule: ACKED stores transport ack/version metadata only; domain acceptance meaning remains consumer-owned
mechanism_contract.persistence_rule: primitive defines queue-entry lifecycle only; storage engine/database ownership remains consumer/adapter-specific

acceptance_conditions: queue identity uses immutable event_id/idempotency_key and is not derived from state digest
retry is bounded and transitions to DEAD_LETTER
backoff is deterministic and bounded
ACKED and SUPERSEDED are terminal queue mechanics only
domain conflict resolution and authority stay outside the primitive

Ready-Set.scope: Ready local-first outbox uses shared queue lifecycle for PENDING/IN_FLIGHT/RETRY/ACKED/DEAD_LETTER/SUPERSEDED while Ready retains conflict/auth/storage semantics
Ready-Set.semantic_boundary: Ready retains scope meaning, family authentication, remote conflict detection, KEEP_LOCAL/ACCEPT_REMOTE resolution and IndexedDB schema ownership.
Ready-Set.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

capabilities.title: Generic OCR/vision ingestion mechanics
semantic_exclusions: prompt content or business extraction schema

mechanism_contract.manifest_rule: normalize source identity/mime/size and explicit analyzability without inferring document meaning
mechanism_contract.request_rule: build provider-agnostic ingest request with opaque source and metadata
mechanism_contract.result_rule: normalize provider output into opaque result items linked to evidence source ids
mechanism_contract.evidence_rule: validate that result evidence links only reference known source ids
mechanism_contract.confidence_rule: confidence is opaque numeric metadata; threshold meaning remains consumer-owned

acceptance_conditions: manifest normalization is deterministic
unsupported or excluded sources are explicit rather than silently analyzed
generic result evidence cannot reference unknown source ids
shared primitive does not define OCR prompts, extracted business fields, review authority or commit semantics
consumer may retain provider-specific transport and domain-specific interpretation

Ready-Set.scope: Ready capture analysis uses shared manifest/request/result/evidence validation and rejects unknown evidence source ids before domain commit.
Ready-Set.semantic_boundary: Ready retains ANSWER_REFERENCE exclusion meaning, Parent review, FACT confirmation, provider transport/auth, capture storage and assignment interpretation.
Ready-Set.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

Hide-Seek.scope: Hide single-photo and batch OCR use shared source manifest/request/result/evidence mechanics.
Hide-Seek.semantic_boundary: Hide retains Gemini prompts, English-Korean pairing, confidence/review semantics, API credentials, capture-session meaning and sheet commit semantics.
Hide-Seek.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

Snap-Pop.finding: Current Snap runtime has no OCR/vision ingestion path requiring CAP-OCR-INGEST-001.
Snap-Pop.decision: Do not add an unused shared vision primitive.

capabilities.title: External/Public API request-cache-rate-limit adapter mechanics

mechanism_contract.request_rule: normalize method/headers/body/timeout without owning endpoint, credentials or auth authority
mechanism_contract.response_rule: normalize HTTP status into transport categories and parse JSON opportunistically
mechanism_contract.rate_limit_rule: parse Retry-After into retry_after_ms without deciding domain scheduling policy
mechanism_contract.retryability_rule: mark timeout, 429 and 5xx as technically retryable; actual retry decision remains consumer-owned
mechanism_contract.auth_rule: 401/403 are normalized as AUTH_REJECTED only; shared transport never decides identity, role or permission

acceptance_conditions: request body/header normalization is deterministic
Retry-After parsing supports seconds and HTTP-date forms
HTTP status normalization does not infer business meaning
authentication rejection is reported but identity/permission decisions remain outside shared transport
consumer owns endpoint, credentials, retry scheduling and response interpretation

Hide-Seek.semantic_boundary: Hide retains Gemini endpoint/model selection, API key ownership, prompt content, vocabulary semantics and user-facing error meaning.
Hide-Seek.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

Ready-Set.scope: Ready sync adapter uses shared timeout/JSON/status/Retry-After transport normalization.
Ready-Set.semantic_boundary: Ready retains endpoint configuration, family authentication, 409 conflict meaning, retry scheduling and response semantics.
Ready-Set.claim_boundary: CODED + CI_VERIFIED + RUNTIME_VERIFIED; not DEVICE_VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_VERIFIED

Snap-Pop.decision: Do not add an unused shared HTTP primitive.
